name: Bay Ridge Kittens
region_note: SOUTH & SW BROOKLYN (Sunset Park / Bay Ridge / Midwood / Sheepshead Bay)
notes: Tiny all-volunteer rescue = one person, Maggie Shnayerson (@bayridgekittens, 30K); also Medical Coordinator for Flatbush Cats (not a vet). SPECIALTY: critically ill / underage neonatal kittens + Bay Ridge TNR. Adopts kittens in pairs. Contact via IG/adoption form; Venmo @bayridgekittens; weekend adoptions at My Natural Pet Store, 8318 5th Ave. Textbook first-class solo rescuer.
